'''James Valeri''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Kashyyyk Regionals]] on 22 July 2000 with Ominous Beatdown, according to Steve Wall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1033">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-24-steve-wall-s-kashyyyk-regional-reportd1033/ steve-wall-s-kashyyyk-regional-report], DeckTech (Steve "w0nd3r_b0y" Wall, 24 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-24-steve-wall-s-kashyyyk-regional-reportd1033/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
